name: @sumi-os/docs-workspace
description: Human and machine-readable Sumi documentation product workspace.

scripts.build: node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/corpus-contract build && node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/mcp build && node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs apps/web build
scripts.test: node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/corpus-contract test && node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/mcp test && node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs apps/web test
scripts.verify:mcp: node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/corpus-contract build && node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/mcp verify:push
scripts.verify: node --run verify:repository-policy && node --run lint && node --run duplication && node --run verify:lockfile && node --run verify:contract && node --run verify:mcp && node --run verify:web && node --run verify:compliance
scripts.verify:integration: node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/corpus-contract build && node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/mcp build && node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs apps/web build && node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs apps/web verify:mcp && node --run verify:hosts
scripts.verify:repository-policy: node --test tests/repository-policy.test.mjs tests/release-checkpoint.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-host-files.mjs --tracked && node scripts/verify-workflows.mjs && node --run verify:deployment-assets && node scripts/verify-translation-pairing.mjs
scripts.build:sea: node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/corpus-contract build && node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/mcp build:sea
scripts.verify:compliance: node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/mcp build:sea-bundle && node --run build:compliance
scripts.clean: node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/corpus-contract clean && node scripts/run-workspace-script.mjs packages/mcp clean
